meta.title: Campus scoreboard
meta.line: HubSpot Campus List is the source of truth. Peec, GSC, and local SERP are meters on that list. Goal is enrollment across campuses, not one city.
meta.peec_window: last 30d (23 Aug–21 Sep 2026). 150 prompts. Overall Alpha vis 44.2%.
meta.nyc_note: NYC tracked in Peec, excluded from local board.
meta.footer: NYC excluded from this board. Sister brands excluded. Pre-Announcement is Pipeline. Do not add Peec prompts for a city that is not on this list.
meta.sort: Blind first, then Queued, then no city page, then lowest local score
notes: Overall Alpha Peec vis 42.8% → 44.2% (+1.4 pp). Window 23 Aug–21 Sep 2026 (150 prompts; same ids as 14 Sep).
OAV default filter 45 → 44: Greenwich Port Chester Visible→Hidden (still Open, shares /greenwich/ with Armonk; city cleared Port Chester→carried prior Port Chester).
NEW Pre-Announcement: Alpha Monaco (id monaco); Visible; show_in_dashboard null; no city/website → Blind off default filter.

GSC live this run (was dark 14 Sep): 44 city-page rows; Folsom/Frisco/Tampa null; no invented metrics. CTR hole not assigned (no Verified+measured campus under ~3% CTR with clear weak-meter case; Rank/No Niche preferred).
Biggest Peec movers vs 14 Sep: manhattan_beach −7.4; franklin +5.3; kirkland +4.5; charlotte +4.3; houston +4.1.
San Juan still only default-filter Blind. Queued 0. No Blind→prompted or Queued→measured since 14 Sep.
SERP / pplx_score carried from 14 Sep (16 Aug pplx snapshot, not refreshed). Niche: HubSpot nichecom_profile → Verified; else carry; else Missing. Monaco niche Missing / serp null.
Austin High special-cased OK (hold). Brownsville/Chantilly keep Rank despite serp #1.
show_in_dashboard stored as HubSpot value (true/false/null); scoring coerces null→true. Short Hills show false→true; Jacksonville false→null (still off OAV as Pre-Announcement).
Port Chester off default board (Hidden). Armonk remains Open+Visible on /greenwich/.
